speaker: kai_patel
headline: REDUNDANCY IS WHAT KEEPS ONE FAILURE FROM BECOMING THE WHOLE SYSTEM.
deck: A resilient pathway provides alternate routes instead of forcing every transaction through one fragile handoff.
quote: Decentralisation is useful when it removes single points of failure, not when it merely scatters responsibility.
facts: Alternate nodes keep service moving when one path fails.
Routing rules must remain visible and testable.
Shared standards let separate nodes still interoperate.
Users should experience continuity rather than backend complexity.
takeaway: Good decentralisation creates optionality without abandoning coherence, standards or accountability.
